name: Feature Tabs Carousel
description: Auto-advancing tabbed feature panel on a drifting brand gradient. Numbered pills expand their labels when active, screenshots crossfade and rise, and a white notch with inverse corners hosts the tab strip.
interactions: auto-advance every 6s; pause on panel hover; manual click restarts the timer
IntersectionObserver (0.3) cycles only while the panel is on screen
active pill expands its label: max-width 0 -> 180px + opacity + padding, 400ms
shots crossfade with translateY(12px) rise, 700ms ease 50ms delay
eyebrow text swaps with a 200ms fade
background: 4-layer token gradient drifting 16s ease-in-out alternate
prefers-reduced-motion: drift, transitions and auto-advance disabled
